target_customer: Knowledge workers and companies with repetitive desktop tasks (Warpdrive); blockchain projects needing smart contract security (earlier funded focus)
problem: Repetitive on-screen work needed expensive scripting to automate; Synthetic Minds first applied program synthesis to finding bugs in smart contracts.
business_model: Not stated by sources; software product turning screen recordings into automations
product_category: Program synthesis, desktop automation and robotic process automation

founders.name: Saurabh Srivastava
education: PhD and postdoc in code synthesis using theorem provers (institution not named on the YC page)
previous_startups: YC W15 company applying code synthesis to bio (name not stated on the YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was later Head of Code Research at Essential AI and now works on code capabilities for Nemotron at NVIDIA.

competitors.name: UiPath
competitors.funding_then: $153M Series B in March 2018 and $225M Series C in September 2018

technical_complexity.rationale: Synthesizing programs from screen recordings is research-grade program synthesis.

defensibility.rationale: Program synthesis expertise is rare, but RPA vendors had distribution and could add recording features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: RPA vendors kept growing and added recording and AI features; Warpdrive left no public trace after its YC batch.

market_need_then: RPA was a booming enterprise category in 2018, evidenced by UiPath raising $153M in March and $225M in September 2018. Warpdrive aimed to remove the need for hand-written scripts.

branding.domain_note: Uses warpdrive.co; the site returned an error when fetched.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand evidence found. Warpdrive is a common name used by unrelated products, and the parent name Synthetic Minds is generic.

pivots.from: Smart contract security via program synthesis (the 2018 funded focus)
pivots.to: Warpdrive, screen recordings turned into desktop automations
pivots.why: Not stated; order and timing of the two products unclear from sources

outcome_analysis: Synthetic Minds raised a $5.5M seed in October 2018 led by Pantera Capital with Khosla Ventures for program synthesis aimed at smart contract security, while the YC page lists the Warpdrive automation product. The company is marked Inactive, and no shutdown notice or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public. The founder later worked at Essential AI and NVIDIA, which suggests the company wound down or paused.
notes: Cause of inactivity not public. The $5.5M seed is reported by CoinGeek (published 2018-10-25) and CoinDesk mirrors; Wellfound shows $5.6M over 11 rounds, so other small rounds may exist. The funded story concerns smart contract security, so the link to Warpdrive is unconfirmed. warpdrive.co could not be fetched (503). Competitor UiPath is drawn from a search summary of its September 2018 release, which is also the batch end. Founder prior employers before founding were not found; the Essential AI and NVIDIA roles came after.
